description.en: Windows serial, ADB, SSH tunnel and command bridge for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 把 Windows 串口、ADB、SSH 隧道和命令执行接入 DSH 的板端调试桥。

description.en: Open Windows COM ports, talk to ADB devices, run Windows commands and manage the SSH tunnel from DSH. Includes a native WebView2 board console and live serial/ADB output.
description.zh: 在 DSH 里打开 Windows 串口、调试 ADB 设备、执行 Windows 命令并管理 SSH 隧道；附带 WebView2 原生板端控制台和串口/ADB 实时输出。
